title: Beyond local reconstruction: Geometry-preserving output alignment for binary LLM quantization
abstract: arXiv:2512.21651v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advances in post-training quantization for large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated that low-bit quantization methods can maintain most of the original model performance. Despite such successes, 1-bit quantization remains particularly challenging. A common strategy in 1-bit quantization is to determine binary weights by matching full-precision parameters, following a weight-driven criterion. However, this objective is not directly aligned with the quantized model's objective, which is to preserve the model's output behavior under the impact of quantization. A natural alternative is to adopt output-driven criteria that minimize discrepancies in model outputs using calibration data. Surprisingly, naive output-driven approaches often perform even worse in the 1-bit regime. translated_title: 超越局部重建：面向二值大语言模型量化的保持几何结构的输出对齐
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）训练后量化的最新进展表明，低比特量化方法能够保持原模型的大部分性能。尽管取得了这些成功，1比特量化仍然尤其具有挑战性。1比特量化中的一种常见策略是遵循权重驱动的准则，通过匹配全精度参数来确定二值权重。然而，这一目标与量化模型的目标并不直接对齐，量化模型的真正目标是使模型的输出行为在量化的影响下得以保持。一个自然的替代方案是采用输出驱动的准则，利用校准数据最小化模型输出之间的差异。令人惊讶的是，朴素的输出驱动方法在1比特情形下往往表现得甚至更差。在本文中，我们证明这种失败源于两个根本问题：跨层的误差累积，以及更关键的是，各向异性失真……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了1比特量化中朴素输出驱动方法失效的两个根本原因——跨层误差累积与各向异性失真，并提出了一种保持几何结构的输出对齐方法来改进二值LLM量化。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies two fundamental causes behind the failure of naive output-driven 1-bit quantization—cross-layer error accumulation and anisotropic distortion—and proposes a geometry-preserving output alignment method for binary LLM quantization.
